flags.name: DSV41_GLUE_RQPAD
flags.meaning: Read at import of dsv41_attnout.py (imported only when DSV41_ATTNOUT_OP is set; acts only when its rq part runs). On: dsv41_attnout._launch_rq is rebound to dsv41_r5g_rq.wrap(...). First eager call: synthetic sweep r2 vs new kernel at EVERY M 1..32 on hostile partials (review N2), then a real-data check at each new eager M; q + every SF byte, new kernel's buffers 0xFF-poisoned; any mismatch/exception -> RQPAD off for the process (ERROR), r2 kernel serves. In captures the new kernel runs only after the sweep passed and no check failed. Values other than 0/1/on/true/off/false/'' raise ValueError at import.

flags.name: DSV41_GLUE_RPSPLIT
flags.meaning: Read at import of dsv41_routeprep.py (imported only with DSV41_MOE_ROUTEPREP=1). On: dsv41_routeprep._launch is rebound to dsv41_r5g_rp.wrap(...) for calls with M*6 <= 64. Precompile adds the new kernel's warmup (a failure disables RPSPLIT only). First in-scope eager call: synthetic sweep r2 vs new kernel at EVERY M 1..10 x 2 routings (spread / edge experts 0+383) on hostile x with the call's ids dtype (review N2), then a real-data check at each new eager M; separately poisoned copies of rows / scale words / layout / inv_perm / ends; mismatch -> RPSPLIT off for the process (ERROR), r2 kernel serves. In captures the new kernel runs only after the sweep passed and no check failed. Other values raise ValueError at import.

DSV41_GLUE_RQPAD=1.basis: t2 rq p50 by M (8.70/5.34/4.16/3.46/3.55 us at M=1/2/4/5/6), 43 calls/step on the walkB path. Review N7: wo_b (PDL) launches off = p50 + succ-gap = 1.87/1.40/1.37/1.22/1.37 us after rq starts and must still run its pre-wait prologue P, so the saving per call is p50 - max(T_new, off + P) (scripts/estimate.txt): T_new 2.5 -> +0.32% for P <= 1.0 us, +0.25% at P = 1.5; T_new 2.1 -> +0.40% at P <= 0.5, +0.35% at 1.0; T_new 3.2 -> +0.18%. Central 0.25 (round 4 said 0.15; kernel-only device timing cannot see P). Alone it sits below the +0.3% promotion bar and w5 control noise was ~0.2%: the 'glue' arm is the one expected to read cleanly

DSV41_GLUE_RPSPLIT=hoist.basis: 40 rp calls/step on the path (t2), FC1 starts 0.38-0.45 us after rp ends; 1 / 2 / 3 us saved per call = +0.19 / +0.37 / +0.56 % G1. Hoist removes 4 of 5 serialised x-load latencies (~0.4-0.8 us each). Uncalibrated: r2-moefront predicted 2.5-4 us for this kernel and it measures 8 (central cut from 0.3 to 0.25)

DSV41_GLUE_RPSPLIT=split.basis: per program = plan + one chunk: removes 4 of 5 chunk load+compute passes (~0.8-1 us each) minus contention from 5x CTAs (<= 60 programs x 5 at M=10, 48 SMs); 1.5 / 2 / 4 us per call. Uncalibrated like hoist (central cut from 0.45 to 0.35); device_test T decides split vs hoist
